pokemonEffects._description: Effects applied to a Pokemon. Each item has: target (which Pokemon), optional battleOnly flag (only usable in battle), optional reusable flag, and an effects array. Each effect has an 'effect' name and optional 'args'.

_targets.partyMember: User picks any party member (medicine, vitamins, PP items, EV berries, evo stones)
_targets.playerActive: Targets the active battler (X Attack, Dire Hit, Guard Spec, Yellow/Red Flute)
_targets.allFaintedParty: Targets all fainted party members (Sacred Ash)

_effects.evBoost: args: {statId: number, amount: number, cap: number}
_effects.evReduce: args: {statId: number, amount: number, threshold: number} — if EV > threshold, set to threshold; else reduce by amount; no effect if EV = 0
_effects.ppMaxBoost: args: {stages: number} — PP Up=1, PP Max=3
_effects.guardSpec: no args — prevents stat drops for 5 turns — battleOnly
_effects.happiness: args: {amount: [low, mid, high]} — secondary effect, only applied if a primary effect succeeds
_effects.evolve: no args — triggers use-item evolution if species has one for this item
_effects.teachMove: args: {moveId: number} — generated from machines data in generate.py for TMs/HMs

battleEffects._description: Effects that affect the battle itself, not applied to a specific Pokemon. pokeballs.ts handles the 'catch' effect.

_effects.catch: args: Ball catch formula params. 'ball_multiplier' is the flat value. 'catch_override: true' bypasses the formula (guaranteed catch). For conditional balls: 'ball_multiplier_bonus' when 'condition' is met. For scaling balls: 'ball_multiplier_min'/'ball_multiplier_max' with 'scale_by' and 'scale_range' [low, high]. 'passive' for non-catch effects (e.g. happiness-200).
_effects.flee: no args — ends a wild battle

overworldEffects._description: Effects on the overworld/game state, not applied to a specific Pokemon.

_effects.repel: args: {steps: number} — prevents wild encounters below lead Pokemon's level for N steps
_effects.escape: no args — teleport out of cave/dungeon
_effects.encounterRate: args: {modifier: 'decrease'|'increase'} — modifies wild encounter rate while in area

heldEffects._description: Passive effects when held by a Pokemon. Each effect has a 'trigger' (when it activates), an 'effect' (what it does), optional 'args', and optional 'oneShot' (consumed after activation). Items may have 'speciesIds' to restrict to specific species.

_triggers.passive: Always active — modifies stats, type damage, evasion, crit rate, etc.
_triggers.turnEnd: Activates at end of each turn
_triggers.onHit: Activates when holder is hit by an attack
_triggers.onLowHp: Activates when HP drops to/below threshold — args: {threshold: fraction}
_triggers.onStatus: Activates when holder is afflicted with a status condition
_triggers.onPpDepleted: Activates when a move reaches 0 PP
_triggers.onStatDrop: Activates when holder's stats are lowered

_effects.typeBoost: args: {typeId: number, multiplier: number} — multiplies damage for moves of that type
_effects.statMultiplier: args: {statId: number, multiplier: number} — multiplies a stat value
_effects.ppRestore: args: {amount: number} — restore PP to depleted move
_effects.statusCure: args: {statusIds: number[]} — cure listed status conditions
_effects.statBoost: args: {statId: number|'random', stages: number} — boost stat stage(s)
_effects.accuracyReduction: args: {amount: number} — reduce opponent's accuracy (fraction, e.g. 0.1 = 10%)
_effects.flinchChance: args: {chance: number} — add flinch chance to non-flinch moves (fraction)
_effects.speedPriority: args: {chance: number} — chance to move first regardless of speed (fraction)
_effects.surviveHit: args: {chance: number} — chance to survive a KO at 1 HP (fraction)
_effects.drainHp: args: {fraction: number} — restore fraction of damage dealt as HP
_effects.resetStats: no args — reset all negative stat changes to 0
_effects.evMultiplier: args: {multiplier: number} — multiply EV gains from battle
_effects.speedHalve: no args — halve speed in battle
_effects.expShare: no args — gain exp share from battle without fighting
_effects.moneyMultiplier: args: {multiplier: number} — multiply prize money from trainer battles
_effects.encounterReduction: no args — reduce wild encounter rate
_effects.guaranteeFlee: no args — always flee from wild battles
_effects.moveLock: no args — lock into first move used (paired with stat multiplier)
_effects.contestBoost: args: {conditionId: number} — boost contest performance for a condition
